Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. **q27.**

**Go `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`) served by Echo static middleware with an SPA index.html fallback; `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`**

How it fits together:

- `web/package.json:13` — `pnpm release` runs `vite build --mode release --outDir=../server/router/frontend/dist`, so the compiled React bundle lands in `server/router/frontend/dist`.
- `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` — `//go:embed dist/*` compiles that directory into the binary as `embeddedFiles embed.FS`. `getFileSystem("dist")` (line 115) sub-roots it.
- `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54-59` — `FrontendService.Serve` mounts `middleware.StaticWithConfig{Filesystem: frontendFS}` to serve assets, plus `spaFallbackMiddleware` which turns a 404 on any extensionless path into `c.FileFS("index.html", frontendFS)` for client-side routing. A skipper excludes `/api`, `/file`, `/memos.api.v1*`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and `rss.xml` (lines 82-90), and cache headers are set per asset type (lines 92-105: `no-cache` for HTML, `immutable` for hashed `/assets/`).
- `server/server.go:72` — wired in at startup: `frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`.

Net effect: in production there is no separate web server — the frontend ships inside the single `memos` Go binary.
